items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 15 November 2026 4:15am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 15 November 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure west of Ireland tracking eastwards, bringing frontal systems over the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

South 4 or 5, becoming northwest 5 to 7 through the afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming moderate occasionally rough for a time later.


##Weather##

Rain, then showers later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 5 or 6, decreasing 2 to 4, becoming east or southeast 6 to gale 8 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming smooth or slight, then moderate or rough later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, then rain later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally poor later.
